title: Dankai the scribe
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Bereshit Rabbah 79:6: he defied Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, who fixed his eyes on him, and he became a heap of bones.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heap-of-bones account is Hyman’s report of the Midrash narrative.

The whole Torat Emet digital Bereshit Rabbah 79:6 paragraph names Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai and Dankai Safra and ends the Dankai encounter with his becoming a heap of bones. It does not state the fixing of eyes at that point; that detail remains Hyman’s report in the translation. No additional cave narrative or historical claim is imported.
